title: Uncles in New Orleans brass bands and Joe Gabriel's Thibodaux band
summary: His father played in Joe Gabriel's band; the uncles moved to New Orleans, Clay with the Excelsior Brass Band, Oscar and Olivier with Onward.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
